senses.gloss: शंशमम्, शंशामम्. See √ शम्.
शंस् [cf. Lat. carmen for casmen; Casmēna Camēna; censeo.]
शं॑स m. recitation, invocation, praise, RV.
wishing well or ill to, a blessing or a curse, ib.
a promise, vow, ib. (नरां॑ शं॑स, RV. ii, 34, 6, prob. = नरा-श्˚, q.v.; ऋजु॑र् इ॑च् छं॑स, ii, 26, 1 either, by tmesis, ‘the right praiser’, or ऋजु-शंस as adj. ‘righteous, faithful’)
a spell, MW.
calumny, ib.
शं॑स mfn. reciting, proclaiming, praising, wishing (see अघ-, दुः-श् &c.)
शं॑सा (आ), f. praise, flattery, eulogium, Kāv.
wish, desire, W.
speech, utterance, announcement, R.
सांश mfn. having or consisting of parts or shares, Sāṃkhyapr.
शंसथ m. conversation, PārGṛ.
शंसन n. reciting, recitation, praise, L.
report, announcement, communication, R. (applied to Śiva, Hariv. 7425 = वेद-प्रशस्य, Nīlak.)
सं-शान , सं-शित &c. See सं-√ शो.
सं-शान n. N. of various Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
शंसनीय mfn. to be praised, praiseworthy, Nir.; Rājat.
शंसित mfn. (often confounded with सं-शित See सं-√ शो) said, told, praised, celebrated, Pañcat. praiseworthy, ib.
wished, desired, longed for, W.
calumniated, falsely accused, ib.
सं-शीत , सं-शीन. See सं-√ श्यै.
सं-शीत mfn. congealed, frozen, cold, cool, ŚārṅgS.
सं॑-शित mfn. (often wrongly written शंसित or संसित) whetted, sharpened, ŚBr.
pointed, sharp (see comp.)
ready, prepared for or resolved upon (loc.), AV.; MBh. &c.
made ready, well-prepared, all right (applied to things), VS.; AV.
fixed upon, decided, firmly adhered to, rigid (as a vow), Mn.; MBh. &c.
completing, effecting, diligent in accomplishing, W.
सं॑-शित m. N. of a man g. गर्गादि (cf. सांशित्य)
शंसितृ m. a reciter (= शंस्तृ below), MBh.; VāyuP.; Yājñ., Sch.
= होतृ, AitĀr.
शंसिन् mfn. (only ifc.) reciting, uttering, announcing, telling, relating, betraying, predicting, promising, Hariv.; Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
शंसिवस् mfn. announcing, proclaiming, R.
शंस्तव्य mfn. to be recited, AitBr.

शं॑स्तृ m. one who recites, a reciter, RV.; AitBr. (a priest identified with the Praśāstṛ and mentioned along with five others in RV. i, 162, 5; his sacrificial duties correspond with those of the Maitrā-varuṇa of the later ritual)
a praiser, encomiast, panegyrist, W.
शं॑स्य mfn. to be recited, RV.
to be praised, praiseworthy, ib.
N. of Agni (in a formula), VS.; TBr.; KātyŚr., Sch. (m. the eastward sacrificial fire, L.)
to be wished for, desirable, W.
शं—स्थ or शं—स्था, mfn. being in prosperity, happy, prosperous, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 77, Sch.
शं—स्थ or शं—स्था, mfn. being in prosperity, happy, prosperous, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 77, Sch.
सं-स्था (आ॑), f., see next.
सं-स्था॑ f. (ifc. f(आ). ) staying or abiding with (comp.), MBh.
shape, form, manifestation, appearance (ifc. ‘appearing as’), Up.; MBh. &c.

established order, standard, rule, direction (acc. with √ कृ or Caus. of √ स्था, ‘to establish or fix a rule or obligation for one's self’; with व्यति-√ क्रम् or परि√ भिद्, ‘to transgress or break an established rule or obligation’), MBh.; R. &c.
quality, property, nature, Kāv.; Pur.
conclusion, termination, completion, TS.; ŚBr. &c.
end, death, Pur.
destruction of the world (= प्रलय, said to be of four kinds, viz. नैमित्तिक, प्राकृतिक, नित्य, आत्यन्तिक), ib.
a complete liturgical course, the basis or essential form of a sacrifice (the Jyotiḥ-ṣṭoma, Havir-yajña, and Pāka-yajña consist of seven such forms), ŚrS.
killing (पशु-स्˚, ‘killing of the sacrificial animal’), BhP.
cremation (of a body; also प्रेत-स्˚), ib.
(prob.) = श्राद्ध, MārkP.

a spy or secret emissary in a king's own country (= चर, m. prob. a group of five spies consisting of a वणिज् ‘, merchant’, भिक्षु, ‘mendicant’, छात्त्र, ‘pupil’, लिङ्गिन्, ‘one who falsely wears the mark of a twice-born’, and कृषीवल, ‘husbandman’, cf. पञ्च-वर्ग, and Mn. vii, 154; Kull.), Kām.;
continuation in the right way, L.
occupation, business, profession, W.
an assembly, ib.
a royal ordinance, ib.
सं-स्थ mf(आ)n. standing together, standing or staying or resting or being in or on, contained in (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
being in or with, belonging to (loc. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
based or resting or dependent on (loc.), MBh.
partaking or possessed of (comp.), MBh.; Pañcat.
existing, lasting for a time (comp.), Vet.
ended, perished, dead, L.
सं-स्थ॑ m. presence (only loc. ‘in the presence or midst of’, with चिद्, ‘by one's mere presence’), RV.
a spy, secret emissary (cf. संस्था below), L.
a dweller, resident, inhabitant, W.
a fellow-countryman, neighbour, ib.
शांशप॑ mf(ई)n. (fr. शिंशपा) derived from the Śiṃśapā (Dalbergia Sissoo, a large and beautiful tree), made of its wood &c., AV.
शांशपक mfn. id. g. अरीहणादि.
शांशपायन m. N. of an ancient teacher (also called सु-शर्मन्), Pur.
शांशपायनक mf(इका)n. written or composed by Śāṃśapāyana, Cat.
शांशपायनि m. = शांशपायन.
शांशपास्थल mfn. (fr. शिंशपा-स्थत), Pāṇ. vii, 3, 1, Sch.
सं-√ शंस् P. -शंसति, to recite together, AitBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
सं-शंसा f. praise, commendation, ŚāṅkhBr.

सं-√ शक् P. -शक्नोति, to be capable, be able to (inf.), AV.; BhP.;
 (with न) not to succeed with, not to be a match for (instr. or loc.), TS.; AV.
सं-शकला ind. killing, slaughter, W.
with -√ कृ, p. -करोति, g. ऊर्य्-आदि (cf. शकला).
सं-√ शङ्क् Ā. -शङ्कते, to be very suspicious of (acc.) or with regard to (loc.), MBh. iv, 568.
सं-√ 2. शद् Caus. -शातयति, to cause to fall down, crush, break to pieces, MBh. iii, 865.
सं-स॑द् f. ‘sitting together’, an assembly meeting, congress, session, court of justice or of a king, RV. &c. &c.
(संसदाम् अयन n. a partic. ceremony or festival of 24 days, ŚrS.)
a multitude number, R.
सं-स॑द् mfn. one who sits together, one who sits at or takes part in a sacrifice, MW.
सं-√ शप् P. Ā. -शपति, ˚ते, to take an oath together, swear, curse, imprecate, MBh.
सं-शप्त mfn. ‘sworn together’, cursed, Kād.
सं-शप्त—वत् mfn. one who has sworn with others, one who has cursed (also as pf. ‘he has sworn or cursed’), Kathās.

सं-˚शप्तक m. a soldier or warrior sworn with others not to fly or give up fighting (till some object is gained), one bound by an oath to kill others (pl. a band of conspirators or confederates such as Tri-garta and his brothers who had sworn to kill Arjuna but were killed themselves), MBh.
सं-सप्तक w.r. for सं-शप्तक
सं-˚शप्तक—वध-पर्वन् n. N. of the section of the MBh. (vii, 17) describing the above.

सं-√ शब्द् (only ind.p. -शब्द्य and Pass. pr. p. संशब्द्यमान), to exclaim, MBh.;
to speak about, mention, ib.
सं-शब्द m. calling out, provocation, MBh.
speech, BhP.
mention, Vop.
सं-˚शब्दन n. making a sound, calling out, MW.
mentioning, Dhātup.
praising, eulogizing, ib.
सं-˚शब्द्य See above and अ-संशब्द्य.
सं-शम॑ m. complete case, comfort, satisfaction, ŚBr.; Bhaṭṭ.
सं-˚शमन mf(ई)n. allaying, tranquillizing, Suśr.
removing, destroying (see पाप-स्˚)
सं-˚शमन n. pacification, Kām.
a sedative, Suśr.
सं-˚शमनीय See वास्तु- and संशोधन-स्˚.
सं-शान्त mfn. thoroughly pacified or allayed, MBh.
extinguished, destroyed, dead, MBh.; R. &c.
सं-˚शान्ति f. extinction, VarBṛS.
सं-शय &c. See सं-√ शी.
सं-शय m. (ifc. f(आ). ) lying down to rest or sleep, L.

uncertainty, irresolution, hesitation, doubt in or of (loc., acc. with प्रति, or comp.; संशयः, with Pot., ‘there is doubt whether’; न स्˚, नास्ति स्˚, नात्र स्˚, न हि स्˚, नास्त्य् अत्र-स्˚ &c., ‘there is no doubt’, ‘without doubt’), ĀśvŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a doubtful matter, Car.
(in Nyāya) doubt about the point to be discussed (one of the 16 categories), IW. 64
difficulty, danger, risk of or in or to (gen. loc., or comp.), ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. &c.
सं-शर॑ , सं-शारुक. See सं√ सॄ, p. 1118 col. 1.
सं-शर॑ m. crushing, breaking, rending, VS.; TBr.
सं-सार &c. See सं-√ सृ below.
सं-सार m. going or wandering through, undergoing transmigration, MaitrUp.

course, passage, passing through a succession of states, circuit of mundane existence, transmigration, metempsychosis, the world, secular life, worldly illusion (आ संसारात्, ‘from the beginning of the world’), Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
w.r. for सं-चार, Bhartṛ.
सं-शरण n. resorting to, seeking, refuge with (gen.), Kām.
सं-˚शरण n. the commencement of a combat charge, attack, L. (prob. w.r. for सं-सरण).
सं-सरण See सं-√ सृ, col. 2.
सं-सरण n. going about, walking or wandering through, MBh.
passing through a succession of states, birth and rebirth of living beings, the world, BhP.; Sarvad.
the unobstructed march of an army, L.
the commencement of war or battle, L.
a highway, principal road, L.
a resting-place for passengers near the gates of a city, W.
सं-सारण n. (fr. Caus.) setting in motion, causing to move away (a car), KātyŚr.
w.r. for -सरण, AṣṭāvS.

सं-√ शास् P. -शास्ति, to direct, instruct, summon, call upon, Br.; GṛS.;
to arrange or put in order with (instr.), TS.
सं-शास् See सु॑-संशस्.
सं-˚शासन n. direction, ŚāṅkhBr.
सं-˚शासित mfn. directed, instructed, Cat.
सं-शि॑स् f. direction, invitation, AV.

सं-√ शिक्ष् Caus. -शिक्षयति, to teach (two acc.), BhP.;
to try, test, Dhanaṃj.

सं-√ शिञ्ज् Ā. -शिङ्क्ते, to utter a shrill sound, ŚBr. :
Caus. -शिञ्जयति, to clash together (trans.), ib.
सं-शिशरिषु See सं-√ शॄ.
सं-शिशरिषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to rend or tear, Nir. vi, 31.
सं-शिश्रीषु See सं-√ श्रि.
सं-शिश्रीषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to have recourse to (acc.), Bhaṭṭ.
सं-शि॑श्वन् mf(अरी)n. having one calf in common (said of cows), RV. (= एक-शिशुक, Sāy.)
सं॑-शिष्ट mfn. (√ शिष्) left remaining, TS.
सं-शय—कर mf(ई)n. causing doubt or risk, dangerous to (comp.), Śiś.
सं-शय—कारणार्थापत्ति-पूर्व-पक्ष-रहस्य n. N. of Nyāya wk.
सं-शय—कारणार्थापत्ति-रहस्य n. N. of Nyāya wk.
सं-शय—गत mfn. fallen into danger, Śak.
सं-शय—च्छेद m. the solution of doubt (˚द्य mfn. relating to it), Ragh.
सं-शय—च्छेद्य mfn., relating to the solution of doubt
सं-शय—च्छेदिन् mfn. clearing all doubt, decisive, Śak.
सं-शय—तत्त्व-निरूपण n. N. of wk.
सं-शय—पक्षता-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
सं-शय—पक्षता-वाद m. N. of wk.
सं-शय—परीक्षा f. N. of wk.
सं-शय—वाद m. N. of wk.
सं-शय—वादार्थ m. N. of wk.
सं-शय—सम m. (in Nyāya) one of the 24 Jātis or self-confuting replies, Nyāyas.; Sarvad. (cf. IW. 64)
सं-शय—सम-प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
सं-शय—स्थ mfn. being in uncertainty, doubtful, W.
सं-श˚याक्षेप m. ‘removal of doubt’, a partic. figure of speech, Kāvyād. ii, 163; 164
संशयातिशय m. exaggeration in the way of suggesting doubts, Kāvyād.
सं-श˚यात्मक mfn. consisting of doubt, dubious, uncertain, Pañcat.
सं-श˚यात्मन् mfn. having a doubtful mind, a sceptic, Bhag.; Sarvad.
सं-श˚यानुमिति f. N. of wk.
सं-श˚यानुमिति-रहस्य n. N. of wk.
सं-श˚यापन्न mfn. beset with doubt, dubious (-मानस mfn. irresolute in mind), W.
सं-श˚यापन्न—मानस mfn., irresolute in mind
सं-श˚यावह mfn. causing danger, dangerous to (gen. or comp.), MBh.
सं-श˚योच्छेदिन् mfn. resolving doubts, Hit., Introd.
सं-श˚योपमा f. a comparison expressed in the form of a doubt, Kāvyād. ii, 26
सं-श˚योपेत mfn. possessed of uncertainty, doubtful, uncertain, MW.
सं-˚शयालु mfn. disposed to doubt, doubtful or sceptical about (loc.), Naiṣ.
सं-˚शयित mfn. irresolute, doubtful about (comp.), KātyŚr.; R.
subject to doubt, uncertain, dubious, questionable, MBh.; Kām.
सं-˚शयित n. doubt, uncertainty, MBh.
सं-˚शयितव्य mfn. to be called in doubt, dubious, problematical, Śaṃk.
सं-˚शयितृ mfn. one who hesitates, a doubter, sceptic, L.
सं-˚शयिन् mfn. doubtful, dubious, questionable, MW.
सं-शीति f. = सं-शय, doubt, uncertainty, Kād.; Hcar.
सं-शिति f. excessive sharpening, AitBr.
सं-शीलन n. regular practice, habitual performance, Sarvad.
frequent intercourse with (gen.), Kāv.

सं-√ सूच् P. -सूचयति, to indicate or show plainly, imply, betray, tell, Kāv.; Var.; Kathās. :
Pass. -सूच्यते, to be indicated &c., Ṛtus.
सं-शोक (prob.) m. = स्वेद, ‘sweat’, ‘moist heat’, in next.
सं-शोक—ज mfn. produced from moist heat (cf. स्वेद-ज), Bādar.
सं-शुद्ध mfn. completely purified or cleansed, pure, clean, Yājñ.; BhP.
removed, destroyed, expiated (see comp.)
cleared off, defrayed, paid, Kathās.
searched, tried, examined, Mn. vii, 219
acquitted (of a crime), W.
सं-शुद्ध—किल्बिष mfn. one whose offences are expiated, purified from sin, Bhag.
सं-˚शुद्धि f. perfect purification or purity (also in a ritual sense), Bhag.; Kām.
cleaning (the body), W.
acquittal, acquittance, ib.
correction, rectification, ib.
सं-शोधन mf(ई)n. (fr. Caus.) completely purifying, destroying impurity (of the bodily humours), Suśr.
सं-शोधन n. purification or a means of p˚, Suśr. refining, clearing, W.
paying off, correcting, ib.
सं-शोधन—शमनीय mfn. treating of purifying and calming remedies, Suśr.
सं-˚शोधित mfn. completely cleansed and purified &c.
cleared off, paid, Kathās.
सं-˚सोध्य mfn. to be completely cleansed &c.
to be purged, Car.
to be paid or acquitted (as a debt), W.
to be corrected or rectified, ib.
सं-शोभित mfn. (fr. Caus.) adorned or shining with (instr.), Ṛtus.

सं-√ 1. शुष् P. -शुष्यति, (ep. also ˚ते), to be completely dried or dried up, MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Caus. -शोषयति, to make dry, dry up, ib.
सं-शुष्क mf(आ)n. completely dried up or withered, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-शुष्क—मांस-त्वक्-स्नायु mfn. one whose flesh and skin and sinews are completely dried up or withered, MBh.
सं-शुष्˚कास्य mfn. having a withered face, ib.
सं-शोष m. complete drying, drying up, VarBṛS.
सं-˚शोषण n. id., MBh.; Suśr.
सं-˚शोषण mfn. making dry, drying up, Car.
सं-˚शोषित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made thoroughly dry, dried up, MW.
सं-˚शोषिन् mfn. drying up, making dry, Subh. (said of a partic. form of fever, Bhpr.)
सं-शून mfn. (√ श्वि) much swelled, swollen, Bhaṭṭ.
सं-शृङ्गी॑ f. (fr. सम् and शृङ्ग) a cow whose horns are bent towards each other, MaitrS.

सं-√ शॄ P. -शृयाति, to smash to pieces, crush, Br.; ĀśvGṛ. :
Pass. -शीर्यते (aor. -शारि; pf. -शश्रे),
to be crushed, break down, RV.; AV.;
to be dissipated or routed, fly in different directions, MBh. :
Desid. See सं-शिशरिषु.
सं-शारुक mfn. breaking down (in अ-स्˚) Kap.

सं-√ शो P. Ā. -शिशाति, -शिशीते (once श्यति, RV. i, 130, 4), to whet or sharpen thoroughly (Ā. ‘one's own weapons’), RV.; TS.; ŚBr.;
to urge, excite, speed, make ready, prepare, RV.; AV.; Br.; KātyŚr.
सं-शित—तपस् mfn. exposed or subjected to painful austerities or mortifications (said of a Śūdra), MBh.
सं-शित—वाच् mfn. using harsh or sharp language, MBh.
सं॑-शित—व्रत mfn. (सं॑-श्˚) firmly adhering to a vow, faithful to an obligation, honest, virtuous, ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
सं॑-शित—व्रत m. a Ṛṣi, Gal.
सं-˚शितात्मन् mfn. one who has completely made up his mind, firmly resolved, MBh.
सं-श्-चत् m. (prob. fr. √ चत्) a juggler, rogue (= कुहक), Uṇ. ii, 85, Sch. (v.l. सं-श्वत्)
सं-श्-चत् n. deceit, trick, illusion, juggling, W.
सं-श्चाय Nom. (fr. prec.), A. ˚यते, g. भृशादि.
सं-√ श्यै cl. 1. P. Ā. -श्यायति, ˚ते, only in the forms below.
सं-शीन mfn. id., Car.
सं-श्यान mfn. id.
contracted, shrunk or rolled up together, collapsed, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 24.
सं-श्रद्-√ धा (only ind.p. -धाय), to have complete faith in, believe, BhP.
सं-श्रान्त mfn. (√ श्रम्) completely wearied, languid, exhausted, MBh.; BhP.
सं-श्राव &c. See सं-स्राव.
सं-श्राव m. (ifc.) hearing, listening to, Kauś.
सं-श्रव m. hearing, listening (loc., ‘within hearing’), MBh.; Mālatīm.
assent, promise, agreement, L.
सं-श्रव mfn. audible (see विदूर-संश्रव).
सं-स्रव॑ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) flowing together, conflux, Suśr.
that which flows together, (esp.) this blended remainder of liquids, RV.; AitBr.; GṛŚrS.
flowing water, R.
any remainder, remains, a chip or piece of anything, MBh.
a kind of offering or libation, MW.
सं-स्राव॑ m. flowing together, conflux, AV.
accumulation of matter &c., Suśr.
the remainder of any liquid, dregs, TS.; Kāṭh.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.
a kind of offering or libation, MW.
सं-√ श्री P. -श्रीणति, to join or unite or connect with, cause to partake of (instr.), TāṇḍBr.

सं-श्रय m. (ifc. f(आ). ) conjunction, combination, connection, association (ifc. ‘joined or connected with’), relationship or reference to (ifc. ‘relating to’, ‘referring to’; ˚यात् ind. ‘in consequence of’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
going or resorting or betaking one's self to any person or place (loc. or comp.), going for refuge or protection, having recourse to (cf. कलि-स्˚), MBh.; Pañcat. &c.
league, alliance, leaguing together for mutual protection (one of the 6 Guṇas of a king), Mn. vii, 160; Yājñ. &c.
a refuge, asylum, shelter, resting or dwelling-place, residence, home (ifc. ‘residing with’, ‘living or dwelling or resting in or on’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
devotion to, attachment to (ifc. ‘devoted or attached to’; ˚यात् ind. ‘by means or help of’), MBh.; R. &c.
an aim, object, MW.
a piece or portion belonging to anything, MBh.
N. of a Prajā-pati, R.
